chapter: Savoy days, the Concord and business
title: Fifteenth-anniversary celebration at the Concord
summary: Local musicians held a dinner and jam session in January 1980.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: January 11, 1980, you had a big celebration here celebrating your 15th year. The big jazz bands, right?

Well, the musicians from around up here in the mountain, besides the hotel and a lot of people, they came in and played and, you know, saying a few good words to make me feel good, had a little dinner, you know, and had a little jam session and all that. You know, all around (inaudible). After that, then they played, it was for maybe one more night. I went out and they had it in another club out there at the racetrack here. So, I went out and joined them out there and it was for me. And then, they was, wanted to pull another one at the racetrack. But, they figured they'd better wait a little while for that one.
